description: Change the workspace's article settings. Only the fields you pass change; the rest keep their values. flexibleScheduling true allows 1 to 5 articles a day and lets you move planned articles by hand. styleSet picks the image style for hero images. get_article_settings shows the current values.

articleSettings.description: The article settings to change. Fields you leave out stay as they are.

autoGenerate.description: Off = fully manual mode: articles are written only on demand (generate_article) and publish only from the editor. Turning it on needs a publishing destination that has already put at least one article live on the site.

autoPublish.description: Publish automatically on each article's scheduled day. False: you review and publish each one yourself. News and trending articles always wait for your approval.

externalLinksPerArticle.description: Links to other sites in each article (0 to 15)

globalInstructions.description: Editorial rules for every article, like "Always mention our free migration service."

includeRelatedReading.description: Related Reading link block at the end

includeYouTube.description: A relevant YouTube video embedded where a walkthrough would help

internalLinksPerArticle.description: Links to your own pages in each article (1 to 8)

titleInHeroImage.description: Write the post title into the hero image

useEmojis.description: Tasteful emojis in headers and lists

flexibleScheduling.description: true allows 1 to 5 articles a day and lets you move planned articles by hand

styleSet.description: Your workspace's image style, one of the 25 styles.

name: update_article_settings
